2. Set OP_KEYSTORE_AUTH_TOKEN + OP_KEYSTORE_URL on API service
3. Build Railway Tor sidecar service from railway/tor-sidecar-deploy/, persistent volume on /var/lib/tor/sthrip-hsv3
4. Capture .onion address, set STHRIP_ONION_ENABLED=true + STHRIP_ONION_ENDPOINT + STHRIP_TOR_SOCKS_PROXY
5. Run scripts/backfill_payment_envelope.py until zero NULL envelopes across 4 tables
7. Set STHRIP_DROP_LEGACY_FK=true; alembic upgrade head — point of no return
Order matters. Skipping any step degrades the guarantees in PRIVACY_FEATURES.md.
